apps.bpm.desc: A fusion of business process management (BPM-CBOK) and Industry 4.0 operations engineering: a Command Console (Cyber-Command HUD) designed to diagnose, audit and optimize manufacturing processes with extremely high analytical density, running on the serverless-edge and client-side paradigm.

apps.bpm.li1: Maturidade Operacional (Escala CMMI): avalia em milissegundos o nível de maturidade dos processos de 0 a 5.
apps.bpm.li2: Engenharia Lean (VA vs. NVA): separa Tempo Agregador de Valor do Tempo Desperdiçado para expor gargalos de redesenho.
apps.bpm.li3: Governança de Riscos (RPFMEA Scatter): correlação baseada nas normas AIAG/VDA de PFMEA.
apps.bpm.li4: Mineração de Processos: identifica anomalias e variantes de fluxo fora do padrão BPMN 2.0.
apps.bpm.li5: Gêmeo Digital: aplicação prática da Lei de Little (Teoria das Filas) para prever gargalos iminentes.
apps.bpm.li6: Alinhamento Estratégico: Radar Multi-KPI cruzando performance com metas do BSC e ISO 9001 / IATF 16949.

apps.lss.desc: A fusion of Lean philosophy, statistical process control and predictive industrial intelligence. A proprietary analytical platform that natively integrates Lean Manufacturing's loss-mitigation methodologies with Six Sigma's statistical rigor, with embedded AI to optimize the industry's most complex flows.

apps.lss.li1: VSM Dashboard: mapeamento automatizado do fluxo de valor, takt time e os 7 desperdícios clássicos.
apps.lss.li2: Control Charts (CEP): as 8 Regras de Nelson em tempo real, com Cp/Cpk e DPMO.
apps.lss.li3: Gestão DMAIC & Funil de Savings: RTY por fase e impacto financeiro contra a meta.
apps.lss.li4: Kanban Digital & Limites WIP: dimensionamento eletrônico dinâmico de cartões.
apps.lss.li5: Waste Hunter & Lean Green (ESG): caça de perdas ocultas e OEE-Energy.
apps.lss.li6: Auditoria 5S & Poka-Yoke Digital: diagramas radar por setor com sugestão de dispositivos à prova de erros.

apps.lss.title: Lean Six Sigma + Lean Manufacturing — Industry 4.0
apps.pcm.desc: Maintenance 4.0 through the PCM EAM/CMMS Cockpit: an extremely analytically dense platform designed to centralize operations, anticipate failures and optimize the lifecycle of complex industrial assets. Coded to run 100% client-side and serverless-edge, processing sensitive data in milliseconds and persisting everything redundantly via IndexedDB and localStorage.
apps.pcm.imgAlt: Thumbnail of the PCM-EAM/CMMS demo video
apps.pcm.li1: Operação: OEE, Disponibilidade, Desempenho, Qualidade, Backlog e Downtime em gauges de Classe Mundial, com Plano Mestre de 52 semanas em heatmap.
apps.pcm.li2: Confiabilidade Avançada: Distribuição de Weibull por ativo via median ranks, com cálculo de RUL no Digital Twin.
apps.pcm.li3: Engenharia de Análise de Falhas: FMEA/FMECA com RPN automatizado, RCA por Ishikawa (6M) e 5 Porquês.
apps.pcm.li4: Gestão Financeira & LCC: Custo de Ciclo de Vida cruzado com Spare Parts MRO, energia e métricas ESG.
apps.pcm.li5: Simulação Estatística: Monte Carlo em tempo real com referências de risco P50 e P90.
apps.pcm.title: PCM-EAM/CMMS Cockpit Ecosystem — Industry 4.0
apps.pmp.desc: Engineering and project management at the edge of analytical automation. Alongside, you'll see Maintenance 4.0 materialized and integrated with the strictest PMBOK/PMI methodologies — a proprietary, analytically dense platform, custom-built for mission-critical industrial environments and large engineering projects. A solution designed to run deterministically client-side and serverless-edge.

apps.pmp.kicker: Turning raw data into prescriptive decisions
apps.pmp.li1: Gantt Ultra & Linha HOJE: WBS avançada, baseline vs. real, Caminho Crítico em tempo real.
apps.pmp.li2: Motor CPM Nativo: Forward/Backward Pass real, folgas negativas acusadas na hora.

apps.pmp.li4: EVM ERP: Planejado × Entregue × Custo Real, com EAC e TCPI automatizados.

apps.pmp.li6: Módulo Paradas 24h: correlação de microparadas e Bad Actors do chão de fábrica.

apps.sst.desc: Occupational Health and Safety (SST-SGG) integrated with Culture 4.0: an extremely analytically dense ecosystem built to centralize, audit and anticipate occupational risks in manufacturing plants and heavy engineering operations, running 100% client-side and serverless-edge.

apps.sst.li2: PCMSO & Saúde Ocupacional (NR-07): Métricas de aptidão, exames e restrições.

bio.fw1: Pain mapping: identifying the real management bottleneck in the operation.
bio.fw2: Business modeling: structuring metrics, rules and calculations that generate value for the decision-maker.
bio.fw3: Data engineering: building the architecture and the deterministic calculation engines.
bio.fw4: UX/UI Design: designing the user experience and interface with a focus on the factory environment.
bio.fw5: Validation: practical testing with real production data.
bio.p1: Production Engineer specialized in Industrial Management, with expertise in building client-side and serverless-edge technology solutions. My work focuses on assertive decision-making, delivering results and continuous improvement. I combine governance, reliability and process methodologies with the ability to map, architect and code high-performance ecosystems, translated into Integrated Management applications.
bio.p2: After a period dedicated to teaching, I redirected that technical and managerial background to where it generates direct impact: industrial operations. Using autonomous agents, advanced prompt engineering, automations and orchestrated workflows, I built 5 complete industrial management applications — each designed to solve a real shop-floor pain point.
bio.p3: The result is a set of solutions that integrate business rules, operate on real-time data and work as deterministic tools. They mitigate operational bottlenecks and enable agile decision-making, grounded strictly in technical parameters.
bio.p4: It's exactly the discipline of a Technical Product Owner (PO): translating the language of operations into the semantics of code, permanently closing the communication gap between those who live the problem and those who build the solution.
bio.title: Applied production engineering, translated into code.

journey.p1: Years dedicated to technical-professional teaching at FIEB/SENAI. That's where I learned, in practice, that teaching well requires deeply understanding the pain of the person on the other side.
journey.p2: I redirected that background into industrial operations, putting the MBAs and specializations accumulated along the way to work on real management problems — no longer just in theory.
journey.p3: I decided to go one step further: use applied AI and prompt engineering to build, on my own, the tools the industry really needs. The 5 apps in this portfolio are the result of that step.
journey.p4: Today, I'm looking for where this combination — technical management expertise and the ability to build — generates the most impact: in an industry, in a software product, or as a consultant.
journey.subtitle: Before writing the first line of any of these apps, the path went through other places — and each of them left a mark on what this portfolio is today.
journey.title: From the classroom to code that manages factories

manifesto.p1: Your company runs on ERP and isolated spreadsheets, but the systems aren't integrated. The most critical factor is the lack of a deterministic connection between operational data and strategic management.
manifesto.p2: Maintenance and planning teams act reactively, limited to putting out daily fires.
manifesto.p3: Invisible losses caused by task distribution without the backing of risk matrices and predictive modeling.

metrics.bpm.conclusion: Lean optimization and failure blocking via RPFMEA (items 2 and 5) remove hidden waste that easily exceeds R$450,000/year in direct savings.
metrics.introText: The figures below make up a model scenario with simulated data (R$100M/year plant), used to demonstrate the calculation logic of each app's analytical engines. Note: these are not audited data or results from a specific client.
metrics.lss.conclusion: Adding up idle inventory, energy and the savings funnel (items 4, 5 and 6), the module delivers R$940,000 in tangible financial return.
metrics.pcm.conclusion: Focusing on inventory, energy and LCC decisions (items 3, 4 and 7), the module adds an extra R$1,120,000 in return or direct liquidity.
metrics.pmp.conclusion: Adding up just budget, labor and quality (items 3, 5 and 6), the platform generates a direct return of R$810,000/year — not counting the indirect gain from increased OEE.
metrics.sst.conclusion: Adding up tax (FAP), litigation prevention and claims ratio (items 3, 6 and 7), this module returns R$682,500/year in direct cash to leadership.
